name: Microsoft SQL Server 2025 with Backups
description: SQL Server 2025, Express edition by default, with daily Bucket backups.

ACCEPT_EULA.description: Required: type Y to accept the Microsoft SQL Server licence terms (https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkId=746388). Any other value keeps SQL Server stopped.

MSSQL_PID.description: Edition: Express (free, licensed for production, 50 GB per database), EnterpriseDeveloper or StandardDeveloper (free, dev/test only), Evaluation (180 days), Standard/EnterpriseCore or a product key (your own licence).

MSSQL_SA_PASSWORD.description: Password of the sa administrator, generated at deploy. Applied on the first boot only; change it later with ALTER LOGIN sa, then update this variable.

MSSQL_DATABASE.description: Database created at boot if missing (letters, digits, _). Empty = none.

MSSQL_APP_USER.description: Login created at boot with db_owner on MSSQL_DATABASE only; use it in apps instead of sa.

MSSQL_APP_PASSWORD.description: Password of MSSQL_APP_USER, generated at deploy. Re-applied at every boot, so changing it here and redeploying changes the login.

MSSQL_COLLATION.description: Server collation on the first boot (e.g. Latin1_General_100_CI_AS_SC_UTF8). Empty = SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS.

MSSQL_MEMORY_LIMIT_MB.description: Memory SQL Server may use, in MB (minimum 2048). Empty = 80% of the service limit. Express uses at most 1,410 MB for its buffer pool anyway.

MSSQL_TRACE_FLAGS.description: Startup trace flags, comma-separated. 1800 = 4 KB-aligned log writes, needed on Railway volumes. Empty = none.

MSSQL_BACKUP_TOKEN.description: Bearer token for the private backup/restore endpoint on PORT, generated at deploy. The SQL Server Backup job references it.

PORT.description: Port of the healthcheck and backup helper (private network only; SQL Server itself listens on 1433).

MSSQL_HOST.description: Private hostname of this server for other services.

MSSQL_PORT.description: SQL Server port on the private network.

MSSQL_URL.description: Private connection URL (go-mssqldb, node mssql, SQLAlchemy-style URL drivers) as the app login.

MSSQL_PUBLIC_URL.description: Connection URL from outside Railway through the TCP proxy (egress is billed).

MSSQL_CONNECTION_STRING.description: ADO.NET / Microsoft.Data.SqlClient connection string over the private network.

MSSQL_PUBLIC_CONNECTION_STRING.description: ADO.NET connection string through the TCP proxy (SSMS, Azure Data Studio, VS Code).

MSSQL_JDBC_URL.description: JDBC URL over the private network.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Time SQL Server gets to shut down cleanly (checkpoint) on redeploy.

MSSQL_HELPER_PORT.description: Port of the helper in the SQL Server container.

MSSQL_BACKUP_TOKEN.description: Token for the helper's backup endpoint (kept in sync by reference).

BACKUP_S3_BUCKET.description: Railway Bucket that stores the backups.

BACKUP_S3_FORCE_PATH_STYLE.description: Keep false: Railway Buckets use virtual-hosted-style URLs.

BACKUP_PREFIX.description: Folder in the bucket; each run writes {prefix}/{UTC timestamp}/.

BACKUP_DATABASES.description: Databases to back up, comma-separated. Empty = every online user database.

BACKUP_RETENTION_DAYS.description: Delete complete runs older than this many days.

BACKUP_KEEP_MIN.description: Always keep at least this many complete runs, whatever their age.

BACKUP_ZSTD_LEVEL.description: zstd level 1 (fast) to 19 (small). Express cannot compress backups itself.

BACKUP_WAIT_SECONDS.description: How long a run waits for SQL Server before failing.

RESTORE_RUN.description: Restore only (start command /usr/local/bin/mssql-backup restore): run folder to restore, or latest.

RESTORE_DATABASE.description: Restore only: database to restore from that run. Empty = MSSQL_DATABASE.

RESTORE_TARGET.description: Restore only: name of the restored database. Empty = {database}_restored.

RESTORE_OVERWRITE.description: Restore only: true allows replacing an existing database of that name.
